text_block_list.text: Admire Groove wasn't feeling well, so I brought her to the nurse's office.
choice_data_list: Let's get a good night's sleep and get into top shape.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ――Understood. Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. What was I—?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really feels like a dream.
To think I'd be having tea together with Alv-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Still-san?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Here, take a look.
Gateau chocolat, chocolate chip cookies,
chocolate parfaits...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"It's like a chocolate paradise, isn't it?♪
Let's enjoy it to our hearts' content today!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. ...Indeed.
I'm looking forward to it as well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, delicious! This smooth sweetness,
it feels like happiness is spreading all through my mouth...♪"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, truly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
! Wow...
Even chocolate this huge...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems this is this cafe's special menu item.
Let us enjoy it together to our hearts' content♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's so heavenly it might melt me away♪
I think I could get addicted to this...♡

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's the matter?
It looks like your hands have stopped...
Don't hold back, eat as much as you like♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Something is definitely wrong.
There's no way I would ever become
this obsessed with chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Still-san doesn't act or talk
in a way that lays her appetite bare like that.
...Who on earth are you?"

...Fufu, ahahaha...!
To think you'd actually notice...!

"You really are a stubborn girl... If only you'd just quietly
surrender your body and soul to chocolate!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ! So you've revealed your true form... Chocolate Fiend!

text_block_list.name: Chocolate Demon
text_block_list.text:
I know the truth.
Deep down, your heart truly yearns for chocolate—

text_block_list.name: Chocolate Demon
text_block_list.text:
I'll grant that wish of yours!
Now, let your instincts take over and devour this chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! 
...No, I will never yield--

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because my heart is screaming at me to cast off all weakness.
I will sever it once and for all...
This sweet temptation of chocolate—!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That just now was――

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What a strange dream.
Still—I didn't lose...
